name: Malpartida de Plasencia (Spain)
description: Green field with a white pall couched, its arms issuing from the hoist corners and its stem running to the middle of the fly.
history: The arms and the flag of Malpartida de Plasencia were approved by the Order of 24 November 1998 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 5 December 1998, after the municipal council's approval on 7 April 1997; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, a green cloth with a heraldic pall couched whose ends lie at the hoist corners and the midpoint of the fly.

features.role: pall couched from the hoist corners to the middle of the fly
